name: Broxbourne Local Plan 2018-2033: A Framework for the Future Development of the Borough

housing-numbers.notes: Required housing is for 2016-2033 period (7,718 dwellings or 454 per year). Total supply as modified is 8,330 dwellings. Commitments figure is for sites with planning permission at 1 April 2018. Local plan sites include both Green Belt releases and non-Green Belt allocations.
